three steps earlier cart already near edge and moving outward at v~-1.34

counterfactual.change: changed initial.x from -0.2402 to 0.0 only; same 223 steps. Drift origin removed so cart stays on track with no violation.

explanation: No pushes and tiny controller forces (~0.5N vs 44N limit), pole stays upright (margin ~0.72). Controller regulates angle/rate but leaves steady cart drift: starting from x=-0.24 with omega=-0.22, cart velocity goes increasingly negative (-0.24 at step50, -0.40 at step100, -1.09 at step200) and position integrates monotonically off the track at step223. Recentering initial x to 0 removes the failure.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.419 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart sits near the left side of the track and drifts further left across frames 220 to 223 while the pole stays nearly upright. No tipping or sudden jump is visible; the failure is the cart leaving the allowed track region.
